findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_project, get_home, get_epos, get_contact, get_references, list_docs, list_news · Private data: get_contact, get_platform · Public sink: get_contact, get_platform_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_project, get_home, get_epos, get_contact, get_references, list_docs, list_news · Private data: get_contact, get_platform · Public sink: get_contact, get_platform_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
